name: effort-router
description: Classifies each message as discussion, design or implementation, sets the main loop's effort to match without changing its model, and hands implementation to an implementer agent on a second model.

main_model.title: Main model
main_model.description: Model of the main loop. Only a session whose model id contains this text is routed, and the mod never changes its model; empty routes a session on any model.

sub_model.title: Sub model
sub_model.description: Model of the implementer agent, which does the code changes in impl: an alias or a full id. Other subagents keep their own models.

chat_main_effort.title: Chat main effort
chat_main_effort.description: Effort of the main loop on a discussion message.

design_main_effort.title: Design main effort
design_main_effort.description: Effort of the main loop on a design message.

impl_main_effort.title: Implementation main effort
impl_main_effort.description: Effort of the main loop on an implementation message.

impl_sub_effort.title: Implementation sub effort
impl_sub_effort.description: Default effort of the implementer agent; the main model may pass another on a call.

classifier_model.title: Classifier model
classifier_model.description: Model that decides chat, design or impl for each message: an alias or a full id.

classifier_timeout_ms.title: Classifier timeout (ms)
classifier_timeout_ms.description: How long the classifier may take before the mode in force is kept.

classifier_min_confidence.title: Classifier minimum confidence
classifier_min_confidence.description: Confidence from 0 to 1 the classifier must give its answer for the mode to change. An answer below it keeps the mode in force; 0 accepts every answer.

delegate.title: Delegate implementation
delegate.description: On an implementation message, tell the main model to hand the code changes to the implementer agent. Off: only the effort changes.

verbose.title: Show classifier status
verbose.description: Show in the band how the last message was routed: the classifier's answer, confidence and time, or the timeout, failure or unsure answer that kept the mode. Off: the band shows the mode, model and effort only; /route still reports it.
